Name: Shane post-marriage Flower Dance dialogue tweak
Author: springacres
Description:
***ONLY AVAILABLE FROM NEXUSMODS.COM AND COMMUNITY.PLAYSTARBOUND.COM!***

[edit 3/1/2026]  When I first made the mod, Shane's unedited post-marriage Flower Dance dialogue was just "Dance? Hoo-boy. Okay... let me chug a few more of these first..." which was
very jarring to me considering his arc.  I haven't been very active in the SDV community for the past few years and only just realized CA
himself had softened Shane's dialogue since I made the mod.  I'm leaving this up for the same reason I created it - I wanted dialogue in that scene that acknowledged both his struggles and his care for the farmer.

The old XNB version of this mod no longer works.  I have uploaded two updates, one that requires Content Patcher and one that does not.

For the Content Patcher version:

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.
[*]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.
[*]Download the Content Patcher-compatible version of this mod.
[*]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
For the XNB version:
[list=1]
[*]﻿Find the directory where Stardew Valley is installed.  For the Steam version, open Steam, find Stardew Valley in your library, right click, select Properties, go to Local Files and click Browse Local Files. From there, go to Contents/Resources/Content/Strings.

[*]Find the original StringsFromCSFiles.xnb and rename it to something like StringsFromCSFiles_old.xnb.

[*]E﻿xtract the modded StringsFromCSFiles.xnb and move it to the Strings folder.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
